title: 🐛 fix(run): decode installpkg file URIs once

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,2 @@
+A ``file:`` URI passed to ``--installpkg`` is now percent-decoded once instead of twice, so a path containing a literal
+``%`` sequence, such as a directory named ``feature%2Flogin``, selects the package the user named.

@@ -77,7 +77,7 @@ def _resolve_path(raw: str) -> Path:
         """Convert a raw string (possibly a ``file:`` URI) to an absolute :class:`~pathlib.Path`."""
         if raw.startswith("file:"):
             parsed = urlparse(raw)
-            path = Path(url2pathname(unquote(parsed.path)))

+def test_install_pkg_file_uri_decoded_once(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    directory: Final[Path] = tmp_path / "feature%2Flogin"
+    directory.mkdir()
+    path: Final[Path] = directory / "pkg-1.0.whl"
+    path.write_text("")
+    uri: Final[str] = path.as_uri()
+    assert "%252F" in uri
+    namespace: Final[Namespace] = Namespace()
+    InstallPackageAction(option_strings=["--install-pkg"], dest="into")(ArgumentParser(), namespace, uri)
+    assert namespace.into == path
+
